source: In the S bus, in the rush hour. A chap of about 26, felt hat with a cord instead of a ribbon, neck too long, as if someone’s been having a tug-of-war with it. People getting off. The chap in question gets annoyed with one of the men standing next to him. He accuses him of jostling him every time anyone goes past. A snivelling tone which is meant to be aggressive. When he sees a vacant seat he throws himself on to it. Two hours later, I meet him in the Cour de Rome, in front of the gare Saint-Lazare. He’s with a friend who’s saying: "You ought to get an extra button put on your overcoat." He shows him where (at the lapels) and why.

Security tightened.

They watched, as they searched, if they faltered, then they halted, and they checked again, meticulously, amidst the tense stillness of suspicion.

The officer, vigilant, approached them, who could, would assess, might delve deeper, amidst the quiet pressure of procedure.

Thusly, each individual, whose documents were scrutinized, whose movements were tracked, might feel the chill of inquiry, amidst the sterile aura of command.

Their eyes, did they stray, from the prescribed path, might find themselves amidst the scrutiny of protocol, whose enforcement demanded compliance, amidst the rigid demands of regulation.

They complied, they submitted, they endured, amidst the unyielding demands of security.

Amid the throng, the bustling crowd surged through the checkpoint, depositing bags into trays with practiced ease. This long queue, weaving through barriers, divested belongings with increasing impatience as sixty passengers awaited their turn to pass through security, each traveler carefully stepping away from the scanner, placing hands against the wall, while officers scrutinized images, ensuring compliance with strict protocols, so that every individual felt watched and known, their every move monitored for potential threats. 

The traveler approached the barrier, stepping briskly, passing swiftly, then halted abruptly when the metal detector chirped loudly, triggering suspicion, causing him to freeze instantly, his eyes widening, turning sharply toward the officer who gestured towards him, requesting silently that he undergo further inspection, knowing fully well that another person beside him was observing closely, watching intently for signs of discomfort or deceit.

Suspicion grew, officers demanded compliance, the traveler hesitated, showing reluctance, but acquiesced under stern looks. Each item removed from pockets, laid meticulously onto the conveyor belt, submitted willingly yet resentfully to the authority's impersonal scrutiny. Every gesture, each movement, was watched closely, with keen interest, as if the very essence of privacy dissolved into the sterile environment of security measures. 

Instructions were clear, travelers moved cautiously, aware of the gaze upon them, each action observed keenly by watchful eyes. Every moment stretched, tension palpable, the traveler waited silently, enduring patiently, as the officer completed the search with meticulous care, every second seeming to drag interminably.
